## Type of change

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] All tests pass locally (`uv run pytest` and `cd frontend && npm run lint && npm run build`)
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, or personal data in the diff
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]` if user-facing
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior or interface changed
- [ ] Self-review of the diff done
